Station Characteristics

  • Prior to the , , <!--, --> extension of this station, this station was the third Floating Station to be built, and is the first Station to feature an Oceanfloor Concourse despite not being an Oceanfloor Station. However, after the expansion, as this station became an Oceanfloor Station due to the addition of eight platforms of Oceanfloor Stylehttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nPrBpdpYz1A&t=600s</ref>, the first example of a non-Oceanfloor Station having an Oceanfloor Concourse became invalid. Instead, this station became the first and currently the only Nazca Railway Oceanfloor Station to feature elevated platforms.

Fun Facts

  • The Oceanfloor Concourse of this station alluded to the first Spawnpoint in Project Nazca which was located underwater.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pm-vCwvEA-0&t=4651s</ref>
  • The Oceanfloor extension part of this station pays tribute to Little Sea Station in Terracept Division.
  • The English Name of this Station is of French Origin, which refers to "The World", which in turn is the last card in the Major Arcana cartomanic Tarot pack.
  • Due to similarities with the words "Lemon" and "Lemonade", these two words became the nicknames of this station.
  • The Chinese name of this station had undergone changes right before the construction of this station.
  • temporarily adopted the right hand traffic rule at this station. As the Up Direction Platforms have doors that open to the left, and the Down Direction Platforms have doors that open to the right, this line would have to adopt the Right-Hand Traffic Rule for the convenience of trains entering the station.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nPrBpdpYz1A&t=361s</ref>
  • The Station Teleportation buttons of this station are placed on the floor in a fashion similar to Centopia.
  • With the increase in platform depth of the Oceanfloor Extension, the building materials also differ to increase the darkness of the color. This arrangement is similar to that of Europa Checkpoint, and the building materials used are as follows:
  • Platforms 3, 5: Block of Quartz, Chiseled Quartz Block
  • Platforms 4, 6: Block of Quartz, Stone Slab
  • Platforms 7, 9: Stone Bricks, Stone Slab
  • Platforms 8, 10: Stone Bricks, Chiseled Stone Bricks

Future Development

  • According to the Station Plans at the outside of this station, the confined spaces between Platforms 4, 6, Platforms 7, 9 and Platforms 8, 10 will be used as Platforms, Concourse and the Concourse of a future Hub Railway line respectively. Moreover, an additional set of Side Platforms will be built below the future Hub Railway Concourse.

History

  • July 18 2020: This station began services alongside .
  • August 25 2021: The , , part of this station began extension. This station became a Checkpoint.
  • August 27 2021: The , , platforms and concourse part of this station completed expansion. At the same day, extends from Darey Terrace Station to this station, but and Platforms remain reserved.
  • September 7 2021: extends from Kallen Bay Station to this station through Quillow Terrace Station.
  • October 7 2021: extends from Astral City Station to this station.

safeHtml:
'''Lean Forest Depot''' was a proposed depot of the Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division that had plans to be constructed at West Metropolis Archipelago Lean Forest Island. This depot would have been the first depot in Nazca Railway to be constructed on an island, and would have acted as a base for , and .

Description

It is only known that this depot would have been constructed at the northwest of Lean Forest Station.

Depot Structure

Connecting Tracks

The reserved connecting tracks to this depot was completed when Lean Forest Station is constructed, and would have emerged at the northwest of Lean Forest Island using tracks with low curvature, where it connects to the shared tracks of , and . However, when tunnels between Midway Island Node and Central Numpool Station/Node was constructed (Midway South Tunnel), the reserved tracks were connected to that tunnel instead. Given these circumstances, it is highly unlikely that Lean Forest Depot will ever be built.

'''Leben Island''' is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. Similar to Centopia Island and the other islands in Centopia, this island is also artificial.

Location

'''Leben Island''' is located to the southwest of Centopia Island, the south of Orama Island and the east of Relish Island.

Transport

Railway

This island features Leben Station of the .

Roads

This island consists of eight roads, namely Shingking Road, Yaugeoi Avenue, Hipgeoi Avenue, Sheunggeoi Road, Hageoi Road, Meigeoi Drive, Lokgeoi Drive and Yigeoi Street. Details of The Roads on this island are as follows:

Shingking Road

Shingking Road starts from a roundabout at the south coast of the island that is connected to Hageoi Road from both sides, and reaches the Diverging Diamond Interchange, which houses Leben Station and serves as the Public Transport Interchange (PTI) of this island. The PTI Provides access to Hipgeoi Avenue and Sheunggeoi Road with a one-lane carriageway in both directions for both roads, before proceeding north to Orama Island.

It should only be noted by the major aspect of Diverging Diamond Interchange, where it adopts Right-Hand Traffic, and the rest of this island adopts Left-Hand Traffic.

Yaugeoi Avenue

Yaugeoi Avenue is the Access Road from this island to Centopia Island. It only intersects with Hipgeoi Avenue at the northeast of this island near Whitemart, and crosses above Sheunggeoi Road and Hageoi Road.

Hipgeoi Avenue

Hipgeoi Avenue is the trunk road of this island, as well as the Access Road from this island to Relish Island. It is mostly a three-lane dual carriageway that is separated by Leben Station and tracks in the center, but would be narrowed to a two-lane carriageway at both the junction with Yaugeoi Avenue at the east and the junction with Meigeoi Drive at the west. The connection to Sheunggeoi Road and Hageoi Road is further narrowed to just one lane in both directions. It should also be noted that while there is apparently only one Ring Road, it is also separated into two sections, with Sheunggeoi Road traversing along the north coast of this island and Hageoi Road traversing along the south coast of this island.

Sheunggeoi Road

Sheunggeoi Road traverses along the north coast of this island. It starts from the west coast of this island where Hageoi Road ends, and intersects with Meigeoi Drive, Shingking Road, Lokgeoi Drive, Hipgeoi Avenue and Yigeoi Street, before joining Hageoi Road at the east beneath Yaugeoi Avenue.

Hageoi Road

Hageoi Road traverses along the south coast of this island. It starts from the east coast of this island where Sheunggeoi Road ends beneath Yaugeoi Avenue, and intersects with Shingking Road at a roundaobut, before proceeding west where it intersects with Meigeoi Drive. Then, instead of following straight westwards, it briefly proceeds southwards before turning northwards once again to follow the island coastline and loop around the proposed Costco-styled Supercenter. Finally, it ends when it joins Sheunggeoi Road at the West, where it is also connected with Hipgeoi Avenue.

Meigeoi Drive

Meigeoi Drive is a road that runs at the west of this island and is divided into two sections. The first section is a north-south oriented two-lane dual carriageway that starts with its junction with Sheunggeoi Road and connects with Hipgeoi Avenue. This section ends at its junction with Hageoi Road, where instead of proceeding straight southwards, it would turn westwards into the second section, which is a two-lane Single Carriageway that cuts through the proposed Costco-styled Supercenter, before ending where Sheunggeoi Road proceeds North.

Lokgeoi Drive

Lokgeoi Drive is a one-lane Dead End Street that branches off from Sheunggeoi Road featuring a Roundabout at its south end.

Yigeoi Street

Yigeoi Street is a one-lane street at the east end of this island that would feature the East Outdoor Grocery Mall at its north side and the Walmart-styled Supermall, which is named Whitemart, at its south side. It connects with Hipgeoi Avenue to the west and Sheunggeoi Road to the east.

Facilities

Immediately after reclamation works completed on this island, it was already announced that this island would feature a Public Transport Interchange (PTI) at the center, with two high-density residential areas, two low-density residential areas, two parks, two outdoor Grocery Malls and two Supercenters, one on each side of the island. Moreover, the west side of this island will also feature a Secondary School and one of the Supercenters which will be Costco-styled, and the east side of this island featuring a Primary School, a Community Center and the other supercenter which will be Walmart-styled.

The following are the facilities on Leben Island in chronological order of completion besides of Leben Station and its corresponding Public Transport Interchange (PTI).

Whitemart

Whitemart is located at the south side of Yigeoi Street and the north side of Yaugeoi Avenue. It is built as the Walmart-styled Supermall for this island, and had completed construction on January 30 2024.

East Outdoor Grocery Mall

The Outdoor Grocery Mall to the East of this island is located at the north side of Yaugeoi Avenue directly opposite to Whitemart. It is built in the style of a Typical Retail Park. It provides a total of 186 parking spaces for three separate buildings which houses five different chain stores.

Fun Facts

  • The name of this island '''Leben''' is taken from the German language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of this island, which could be directly translated to "Cozy Residence".https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/leben</ref>
  • Development on this island have been sub-contracted to other developers in Los Sengas.
  • The English Names of all roads on this island are Homophonic Romanizations from their Chinese Names in the form of Jyutping.
  • The first word of the Chinese Names of Sheunggeoi Road and Hageoi Road alludes to "Up" and "Down", which corresponds to the fact that the roads traverse the north and south coasts of this island respectively.

Development Progress

Currently, the PTI, Leben Station, Whitemart and the East Outdoor Grocery Mall have completed construction.

History

  • December 4 2023: This island completed reclamation works.
  • December 18 2023: Leben Station began services. At the same day, the road link to Orama Island completed construction.
  • December 29 2023: The road link to Centopia Island completed construction. At the same day, this island completed road pavement.
  • January 28 2024: All roads on this island have been named. At the same day, the East Outdoor Grocery Mall and Whitemart began construction.
  • January 30 2024: Whitemart completed construction.
  • January 31 2024: The East Outdoor Grocery Mall completed construction.
